title: Modern Legacy NeoVanilla
description: A modern 64x reinterpretation of Minecraft Vanilla (1.21 style) for 1.7.10
body:
Modern Vanilla for 1.7.10.
This pack brings the look and feel of current Minecraft versions into 1.7.10, updating blocks, items, mobs, and UI to match the modern art style. Designed to stay faithful while refreshing the entire game visually.
